# Quill (MapleSpike) — Full Documentation Archive

> Version: 1.0.0
> Licensing status: package/file declarations conflict; government data terms are source-specific. See `docs/open-source-audit.md` and `LICENSE.md`.
> API Base URL: https://api.maplespike.ca/v1
> MCP Server: https://mcp.maplespike.ca/sse
> Source: https://github.com/maplespike/quill

## Summary

Quill is Canada's sovereign, AI-native government data pipeline — a single
unified layer for government data, corporate influence tracking, committee
surveillance, regulatory intelligence, and policy actor tracking. It ingests,
verifies, and surfaces 208 data modules from Canadian public-sector sources
across every sector, with SHA-256 citation hashes, source provenance, and
audit trails for independent verification. Source-data terms vary by publisher
and dataset; public availability does not itself grant reuse rights.

The product name is Quill: a data-layer MCP server that reads Canada so AI
agents don't have to lie about it. Built with zero external cloud spend,
deployed on a K3s cluster.

## Architecture

```
Internet → Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared pod in k3s)
  ├→ maplespike.ca / quill.maplespike.ca → Portal (:8080) — Astro static + server.py
  ├→ api.maplespike.ca                   → API    (:8082) — Node.js API server (SQLite/PostgreSQL)
  │   ├→ AI Gateway — glm-5.2 via AI Inference Gateway
  │   ├→ Qdrant — vector search for RAG
  │   ├→ Astral Key (proxy) — Web3 SIWE + FIDO2 passkey auth
  │   └→ BYOK middleware — users bring their own AI key
  └→ mcp.maplespike.ca                   → Quill  (:3001) — data-layer MCP server (184 tools)
```

## Packages

- `pipeline-core` — Ingestion, verification, audit (shared library)
- `engine` — Entity resolution, graph building, signals, briefs
- `portal` — Developer portal & landing page (Astro + React + Tailwind)
- `api-server` — REST API gateway (auth, rate limits, usage)
- `quill-mcp` — Quill — data-layer MCP server (184 tools)
- `sdk` — TypeScript client library (@maplespike/sdk)
- `sdk-python` — Python client library (quill-sdk on PyPI)
- `legal-core` — Legal data SDK
- `legislation` — Legislation XML parser
- `database` — SQLite storage (node:sqlite)
- `notification-service` — Notifications
- `create-module` — Module scaffolding CLI
- `docs` — VitePress documentation

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone git@github.com:reverb256/quill.git
cd quill
pnpm install
pnpm run build

# Start MCP server (local stdio)
cd packages/quill-mcp
pnpm start
```

All 184 MCP tools return real data — committees, corporate, influence, and
government data are all searchable via the SQLite database. No external
database configuration required for MCP tools.

For the full local dev stack (API + MCP + Portal):

```bash
./scripts/dev-up.sh
./scripts/e2e-smoke.sh --mode=compose --up --down
```

## Data Coverage

- **Federal core**: IRCC immigration, StatCan WDS (CPI/GDP/labour/pop/trade),
  Health Canada, CRA Charity, Federal Budget, Proactive Disclosure, ATI, NPRI,
  Species at Risk, Impact Assessment, CIPO, CMHC
- **Parliament & committees**: House and Senate committees, Hansard, Canada
  Gazette, LEGISinfo
- **Regulatory & oversight**: OAG, PBO, Ethics Commissioner, Lobbying
  Commissioner, Competition Bureau, CRTC, Privacy Commissioner, Information
  Commissioner, Official Languages, CHRC, OSFI, FCAC, FINTRAC, CDIC
- **Corporate & influence**: Lobbying registry, procurement, SEDI insider
  trades, SEDAR+ filings, corporations Canada, NGO/think tank RSS feeds
- **Provincial**: All 13 legislatures, 13 CKAN portals, 273 regulators
- **Municipal**: 19 cities with direct open data fetchers, 3,490+ via
  provincial CKAN federation
- **Justice & legal**: CanLII case law, Justice Canada legislation XML,
  federal tribunals, Ontario e-Laws, BC Laws
- **Real-time**: ECCC weather alerts (CAP-CP), CBSA border wait times
- **International**: World Bank WDI, UN Comtrade, OECD, Eurostat, WHO, UNDP, UNHCR

## REST API

Base URL: https://api.maplespike.ca/v1
Auth: Send `Authorization: Bearer *** or `X-API-Key: *** header.
All responses follow the MapleSpike envelope: { success, data, error, meta, quality, citation }

### Endpoints

#### GET /v1/health
API health check with usage stats

#### GET /v1/openapi.json
Full OpenAPI 3.1 specification

#### GET /v1/me
Current tenant info and API keys

#### GET /v1/usage
Current billing period usage

#### GET /v1/gov/releases
Latest government data releases

#### GET /v1/gov/search
Full-text search across all sources

#### GET /v1/citation/:hash
Retrieve citation by SHA-256 hash

#### POST /v1/register
Create account and API key

#### GET /v1/verify/:token
Verify email address

#### POST /v1/ai/ask
Ask a question, get a sourced answer (edge AI)

#### POST /v1/ai/search
Semantic search with edge embeddings

#### GET /v1/ai/models
List available AI models

#### POST /v1/ai/analyze
Analyze text for bias, sentiment, claims

#### POST /v1/auth/refresh
Refresh JWT token

#### POST /v1/auth/logout
Clear session

#### POST /v1/billing/checkout
Create checkout session

#### GET /v1/billing/plans
Available pricing plans

#### GET /v1/keys
List API keys

#### POST /v1/keys
Create API key

#### DELETE /v1/keys/:id
Delete API key

#### POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate
Rotate API key

#### GET /v1/signals
Cross-reference signals (requires engine)

## MCP Server

- Endpoint: https://mcp.maplespike.ca/sse (auth-gated)
- 184 tools (incl. x402-deposit), all returning real DB results
- Every record includes SHA-256 citation hashes, source provenance, audit trails
